description_en: Queries all versions of a specified CMK
description_zh: 列出主密钥的所有密钥版本
name: ListKeyVersions

parameters.help_en: The globally unique ID of the CMK. You can also set this parameter to an alias that is bound to the CMK. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68522.html
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页数。  
取值为大于0的整数。  
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 0 to 101.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回的结果个数。  
取值范围：0~101。  
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

KeyVersion.description_en: An array that consists of key versions

CreationDate.description_en: The date and time when the CMK version was created. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationDate.description_zh: 创建密钥版本时的日期和时间（UTC时间）

KeyId.description_en:
The globally unique ID of the CMK.

If you set the KeyId parameter to the alias of the CMK, the ID of the CMK to which the alias is bound is returned
KeyId.description_zh: 密钥ID。如果请求中的KeyId参数使用的是密钥别名、密钥ARN，在响应中也会返回密钥ID

KeyVersionId.description_en: The globally unique ID of the CMK version
KeyVersionId.description_zh: 密钥版本的全局唯一标识符

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned key versions
